descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Jump into **Nightclub Simulator**, a wild VR nightclub where you can do whatever you want — alone, with friends, or in the brand-new **Battle Royale Mode**!

🙌 Meet new people and make instant party friends  
👏 Hype up dancers and control the vibe  
😈 Start drama, mess around, and see what happens  
🏆 Earn achievements as you explore every corner of the nightlife  
📖 Experience Story Mode in multiplayer for even more chaos together  
🔥 Drop into the new Battle Royale Mode and fight to be the last one standing  
🗺️ Explore fun maps or add your own  

Every move changes the night.

The club is alive, the crowd reacts, and now the fight for survival is part of the party.
